_note: Ashwyrm's Roost creatures (levels 31-34 via levelFloor/levelCap; Elite trash, Boss bosses): Dragonsworn, ash elementals, ember whelps, Frostclaw, the Cinder Drakes, Highlord Varkas and Vyrmathra. Instant damage and heals have cooldown >= 6; big casts are Telegraphs; phases and enrages via AI conditions.

creatures.name: Dragonsworn Ashblade
creatures.description: A cultist of the Ashwyrm in crimson-and-bronze scale, greatsword glowing like a poker left in the fire. They swore their names to Vyrmathra. Most of them can't remember what the names were.

creatures.name: Dragonsworn Pyre-Priest
creatures.description: A Dragonsworn in a soot-black cope, who tends the wounded with fire and the unwounded with more fire. Interrupt the mending, or the fight goes on all night.
creatures.bark: Burn, and be mended. Burn, and be mended.

creatures.name: Dragonsworn Wyrmcaller
creatures.description: A Dragonsworn with a bone whistle on a chain. When it blows, small hot things come flapping out of the smoke.

creatures.name: Ash Elemental
creatures.description: Packed ash and cinders, held together by an ember heart and a bad temper. It leaves a trail of warm footprints and a smell like a blacksmith's apron.
creatures.bark: *The ash elemental grinds like a cart of hot gravel.*

creatures.name: Ember Whelp
creatures.description: A chubby red-orange whelp with big eyes, nub horns and no sense of personal space. It is adorable. It is also on fire.

creatures.name: Ashborn Whelp
creatures.description: A whelp called down out of the smoke. It does not know what it is fighting for. It knows it is hungry.

creatures.name: Ash-Maddened Yeti
creatures.description: One of Frostclaw's grown children, its white fur grey with ash-smoke and its eyes gone red. It isn't angry at you. It's angry at everything.

creatures.name: Highlord's Honour Guard
creatures.description: A Dragonsworn in gilded scale, sworn to die for Varkas. Varkas is very much in favour of the arrangement.

creatures.name: Frostclaw the Matriarch
creatures.description: The yeti matriarch of Skyreach, queen of the Shelf since before the Heronguard built their road. The Dragonsworn chained her cubs and burned ash-smoke at her den until she forgot what she was guarding.
creatures.bark: *A roar that brings snow down off every ledge on the Shelf.*

creatures.name: Emberjaw
creatures.description: The elder of the Cinder Drakes: red-orange, molten-jawed, built like a furnace that learned to bite. He guards the pit. His sister guards him.
creatures.bark: *Emberjaw's jaws open, and the light inside is the colour of a forge.*

creatures.name: Ashtongue
creatures.description: The younger Cinder Drake: ash-violet, slim, with a pale violet flame that hangs in the air like smoke. She breathes and he bites. She mends him, too, if you let her.
creatures.bark: *Ashtongue hisses, and violet smoke curls out between her teeth.*

creatures.name: Highlord Varkas
creatures.description: An ogre lord in dragon-scale armour with a whole drake skull for a pauldron. He came to the Ashwyrm for power and stayed for the title. He is very proud of the title.
creatures.bark: I am HIGHLORD Varkas. Say it. All of it. The Highlord part especially.

creatures.name: Vyrmathra the Ashwyrm
creatures.description: The Ashwyrm: a great ash-black dragon, molten at the seams, with a furnace glowing between her belly plates. For four hundred years she has slept on Skyreach and breathed ash on the wind, and everything the ash touched went hollow.
creatures.bark: Little lights. I have eaten kingdoms of little lights.

abilities.name: Searing Slash
abilities.description: A swing of the glowing greatsword: weapon damage plus {0} Fire.

abilities.name: Ember Cleave
abilities.description: A wide, burning sweep: weapon damage to enemies in front.

abilities.name: Sworn Fervour
abilities.description: The Ashblade's oath burns hot: damage dealt increased by 30% for 20 sec.

abilities.name: Flame Lash
abilities.description: A lash of fire from the Dragonsworn's hand: {0} Fire damage.

abilities.name: Cinder Mend
abilities.description: The Pyre-Priest seals an ally's wounds with fire, healing 14% of its health. It can be interrupted.

abilities.name: Ash Ward
abilities.description: Wraps an ally in a skin of hot ash that absorbs damage for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Whistle for Whelps
abilities.description: The Wyrmcaller blows a bone whistle. Two whelps come flapping out of the smoke.

abilities.name: Ember Fist
abilities.description: A cinder fist with glowing knuckles: weapon damage plus {0} Fire.

abilities.name: Cinder Slam
abilities.description: The elemental slams both fists down: {0} Fire damage to enemies within 8 yards.

abilities.name: Smothering Ash
abilities.description: A cloud of hot ash in the face: the target deals 20% less damage for 12 sec.

abilities.name: Nip
abilities.description: Small teeth, very hot: weapon damage plus {0}.

abilities.name: Hiccup of Flame
abilities.description: The whelp hiccups a gout of flame: {0} Fire damage to enemies in front.

abilities.name: Maul
abilities.description: Two huge fists: weapon damage plus {0}.

abilities.name: Rending Claws
abilities.description: Icicle claws rake the target: weapon damage plus {0}, and it bleeds for 12 sec.

abilities.name: Glacial Swipe
abilities.description: A swipe that sprays ice: {0} Frost damage to enemies in front, and they are slowed.

abilities.name: Bitter Cold
abilities.description: The matriarch's breath freezes the whole Shelf: every enemy within 40 yards takes Frost damage every 3 sec for 12 sec.

abilities.name: Avalanche
abilities.description: Frostclaw rears and slams the Shelf, bringing the snow down: {0} Frost damage to every enemy within 40 yards, and they are slowed. Spread out, and heal through it.

abilities.name: Call the Brood
abilities.description: Frostclaw roars for her grown children. Two ash-maddened yetis come down off the ledges.

abilities.name: Call the Brood
abilities.description: Frostclaw roars again. Two more yetis answer.

abilities.name: Matriarch's Fury
abilities.description: Wounded and smoke-blind, Frostclaw goes berserk: damage dealt increased by 40% and attack speed by 25%.

abilities.name: White-Out
abilities.description: The fight has gone on too long: the Shelf vanishes in a howling white-out and Frostclaw fights inside it, damage dealt increased by 300% and attack speed by 50%. Kill her before the snow comes.

abilities.name: Blizzard
abilities.description: Inside the white-out the wind itself cuts: {0} Frost damage to every enemy within 40 yards, every turn.

abilities.name: Molten Bite
abilities.description: A bite with a jaw full of magma: weapon damage plus {0} Fire, and the target's armour softens (stacks to 5). Trade the tank.

abilities.name: Tail Lash
abilities.description: A sweep of the spiked tail: {0} damage to enemies within 10 yards.

abilities.name: Magma Spit
abilities.description: Emberjaw spits a gob of magma at a distant enemy: {0} Fire damage.

abilities.name: Violet Flame
abilities.description: A bolt of pale violet fire: {0} Fire damage.

abilities.name: Ash Breath
abilities.description: Ashtongue rears and breathes a long cone of violet fire: {0} Fire damage to every enemy in front of her, and they choke on ash.

abilities.name: Choking Cinders
abilities.description: Cinders rain over the pit: every enemy within 40 yards burns every 3 sec for 12 sec.

abilities.name: Rekindle
abilities.description: Ashtongue breathes her flame into her wounded brother, healing 12% of his health. Interrupt it!

abilities.name: Grief-Fire
abilities.description: Badly hurt, the drake burns hotter: damage dealt increased by 50%.

abilities.name: Skullsplitter
abilities.description: The dragon-bone maul comes straight down: weapon damage plus {0}.

abilities.name: Wyrmfire Slam
abilities.description: Varkas raises the maul over his head and brings it down in a ring of fire: {0} Fire damage to every enemy within 14 yards, and they are dazed.

abilities.name: Brand of the Wyrm
abilities.description: Varkas raises the drake skull and the Ashwyrm's brand burns into every enemy within 40 yards: Fire damage every 3 sec for 15 sec, and healing taken is reduced by 25%. Remove the curse, and heal through it.

abilities.name: To Me, Honour Guard!
abilities.description: Varkas bellows, and two of his Honour Guard come running from the tents.

abilities.name: Highlord's Bellow
abilities.description: A bellow that shakes the banners: Varkas and his allies deal 20% more damage for 30 sec.

abilities.name: Highlord's Wrath
abilities.description: Nobody has ever made Varkas bleed this much. He takes it personally: damage dealt increased by 50%.

abilities.name: Wyrm Cleave
abilities.description: Claws as long as swords sweep the front ranks: weapon damage to every enemy in front of her.

abilities.name: Tail Sweep
abilities.description: The spade-bladed tail sweeps the ash: {0} damage to every enemy within 12 yards, and they are knocked back.

abilities.name: Wing Buffet
abilities.description: Vyrmathra opens her wings and beats them once: {0} damage to every enemy within 14 yards, and they are dazed.

abilities.name: Fire Breath
abilities.description: Vyrmathra draws a breath that empties the sky, and breathes: {0} Fire damage to every enemy in a long cone in front of her, and they burn. Get out of the cone!

abilities.name: Rain of Cinders
abilities.description: The Ashwyrm shakes her wings, and burning ash falls over the whole summit: every enemy within 50 yards burns every 3 sec for 12 sec.

abilities.name: Take Wing
abilities.description: Vyrmathra leaps into the smoke and screams. Four whelps of her brood come down to fight for her.

abilities.name: Brood of Ash
abilities.description: Her eggs crack in the nest. Four more whelps tumble out, already burning.

abilities.name: Hollowfire
abilities.description: The fire inside the Ashwyrm turns grey: the same grey as the Hollow. {0} Shadowflame to every enemy within 50 yards. Heal through it, or nobody walks down the mountain.

abilities.name: The Last Ember
abilities.description: Vyrmathra burns everything she has left: damage dealt increased by 30% and attack speed by 20%.
